title: Chat cards for Manager, Worker and Reviewer messages
description:
## Objective
In Paseo's chat view, show paseo-bm inter-agent messages (BM-REPORT, BM-REVIEW, instructions naming a request) as compact cards: sender role, colour and icon, sender session name, recipient, request id, status; expand to Markdown; reply to the other agent from the card.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Only paseo-bm messages are transformed (rules in docs/design/paseo-bm-delta-20260916-chat-cards.md §4.1); user-typed messages, ordinary replies, streaming items and other agents' chats stay unchanged.
- Card data validated by a Zod schema; sender and recipient resolved from a read-only chat.peers RPC, never guessed.
- Expanded view renders the full message as Markdown; report fields become a bold-key list.
- Reply sends to the resolved counterpart with the request id prefixed; blocked reports offer prefilled quick replies.
- Tests for classification, resolution, markdown shaping, reply text and the RPC; typecheck, lint, tests, build pass; plugin reloads and runs.

## Provenance
Owner request in chat, 2026-09-16: "tôi cần nhận diện thẻ nhận và phản hồi của 3 agents: Worker, Review và Manager ... Giúp tôi kiểm soát và trả lời nhanh chóng, chính xác với Worker hơn"
close_reason: Chat cards shipped: transformers bm-chat-received/bm-chat-sent + renderer bm-message v1 (index.client.tsx), chat-cards.ts (classification, template detection, parties, markdown, reply text), chat-card.tsx, read-only chat.peers RPC with request-id inference for unlabelled agents. Tests: plugin-chat-cards (19), registration tests updated; typecheck/lint clean, npm test 81 files 1703 pass, build ok. Real daemon after install-reapply-23 (plugin ready): chat.peers resolves all 3 xspace-customer Workers; card code over real timelines gives Manager 46 report cards with correct senders + 1 plain, Worker 3 Manager instructions, Reviewer 1 request + 1 pass verdict to the right Worker. README + delta chat-cards §6. On-screen look left for owner review.

title: Dashboard: read skills and user messages from live agent timelines
description:
## Objective
When a trace is opened, add the skills and user-typed messages of its still-present Workers and Reviewers from their own Paseo timelines, so history from before the collector learned to record them is visible.

## Acceptance Criteria
- traces.get pages each present Worker/Reviewer timeline back (tail, then before+cursor, bounded) and merges skills and clientMessageId messages with recorded ones, once each, oldest first; secrets masked; a Manager is not read.
- An unreadable agent or a host without timeline access adds nothing.
- Tests cover paging, masking, the bound, failures and merging.

## Provenance
Owner, 2026-09-16: "Tôi chưa nhìn thấy được thông tin về skill sử dụng".
close_reason: plugin/server/live-timeline.ts (readLiveExtras, mergeExtras) wired into handleTracesGet; request subtitle uses the larger of recorded and live user-message counts. Real daemon check through the same function: PAKD request -> 395c94f1:feature-workflow (38 ms), Contact request -> 4 user messages (187 ms), beads request -> a2b07689:feature-workflow (73 ms). Tests: test/plugin-live-timeline.test.ts (5). Gates: typecheck, lint, test 1596, build clean.

title: Bead titles first; bead chips in chat cards and a Beads-in-this-chat panel
description:
## Objective
Make beads easy to recognise: titles first in the bead list, and beads named in a chat shown as chips that open the bead, plus an agent panel for plain chat text.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Bead list rows show the title first, the id and chips below.
- Chat cards show chips only for ids the workspace bead store has (beads.lookup); pressing one opens the bead detail with its actions.
- An agent panel lists beads named in the chat's recent messages and shell commands (chat.beads), newest mention first, openable.
- Tests for id finding, chip text, lookup, chat.beads and registrations; typecheck, lint, tests, build pass; plugin reloads and runs.

## Provenance
Owner request in chat, 2026-09-16: "hãy đưa tên lên trước ... click vào mã beads ở đó thì xem đc nội dung beads không"
close_reason: Bead rows title-first (beads-screen.tsx). shared/bead-ids.ts + beads.lookup + chat.peers.workspaceId -> BeadChips on chat cards (title · id, status tone, opens exported BeadDetailPanel). Agent panel 'Beads in this chat' (bm-chat-beads) via chat.beads (2x200 timeline items, messages + shell, real ids only, newest first, max 30). Tests: plugin-chat-beads (6), registration and peers tests updated; typecheck/lint clean, npm test 85 files 1764 pass, build ok. Real daemon after install-reapply-27 (plugin ready): chat.beads on Worker d91ccf32 scanned 400 items in 36 ms, 7 beads, u9zv.12 first; beads.lookup kept only the real id. README + delta chat-cards §7. On-screen look left for owner review.

title: Dashboard misattributes agents of a paseo-bm 0.1.0 Manager
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
Open the Dashboard for the owner's workspace xspace-customer (wks_a217b1fc9568ab78), whose Manager and Workers were created by paseo-bm 0.1.0 (no bm.requestId label on Workers). Request req-20260916T081749Z showed 0 Workers and "0 review calls", while its six labelled Reviewers were listed under req-20260916T062244Z.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A Worker without a label is linked to the request its inbound messages name more often than all others together (bare `req-…` ids count); a tie links nothing.
- A Reviewer's own bm.requestId label wins over its parent Worker's placement.
- Review calls are unknown (null), not 0, when no Reviewer turn was recorded.
- Tests cover all three; the real store yields one Worker per request.

## Provenance
Found while answering the owner's question on 2026-09-16 about which workspace has Dashboard data.
close_reason: plugin/server/traces.ts: requestIdOfAgent falls back to a clear majority of bare req-… ids in the agent's inbound messages (confidence inferred); labelled Reviewers attach by label before parent; reviewCallsOf returns null when no reviewer turn was recorded. Tests in test/plugin-traces-reconstruct.test.ts ('agents from a 0.1.0 Manager', unknown review calls). Real store wks_a217b1fc9568ab78 via the server modules: 081749Z now 1 Worker (395c94f1: 5 mentions vs 3 others) and 6 Reviewers; 062244Z 1 Worker (d91ccf32) + 1 Reviewer; 023934Z 1 Worker (01a17bb0) + 4 Reviewers. Known limit: request text of turns from the 0.1.0 Manager cannot be attributed precisely when requests interleave, because those replies name no request id; 0.2.0 Managers name it. Gates: typecheck, lint, test 1588, build clean; deployed with the running-agent gate.

title: Manager kiểm skills và tra công cụ trước khi tạo Worker nên M-10 vượt xa 5 giây
description:
## Objective
Manager tạo Worker ngay khi nhận yêu cầu (sau khi nhắc lại yêu cầu), rồi mới kiểm skills và báo lại, để thời gian từ lúc giao tới lúc Worker xuất hiện ngắn nhất có thể (M-10 ≤ 5 giây).

## Context
Nghiệm thu F-1 (2026-09-15, evidence m10-raw.txt): Worker xuất hiện sau khoảng 85 giây. Trước khi tạo Worker, Manager chạy kiểm skills bằng shell, tìm công cụ hai lần, list_agents, list_profiles; lần create_agent đầu không tạo được Worker và phải thử lại với settings.modeId. Một phần thời gian là chờ người duyệt quyền (chế độ Always Ask).

## Scope
In scope:
- Đổi thứ tự Workflow trong plugin/roles/manager.md: tạo Worker trước, kiểm skills sau (vẫn nhắc người dùng khi thiếu)
- Nêu sẵn tham số create_agent cần thiết (provider bm-worker/<model từ profile>, labels, settings.modeId từ profile hoặc mặc định) để tránh lần gọi hỏng
- Test nội dung thứ tự bước
Out of scope:
- Thay đổi chế độ quyền của Paseo

## Components Touched
- plugin/roles/manager.md, plugin/server/manager-instructions.ts (sinh lại), test/roles-content-manager.test.ts

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
- Không

## Assumptions / Constraints
- Chỉ dẫn viết tiếng Anh.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Gửi yêu cầu F-1 cho Beads Manager lúc T.
2. Worker createdAt khoảng T + 85 s.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test nội dung: bước tạo Worker đứng trước bước kiểm skills; có tham số create_agent đủ
- npm test toàn bộ, typecheck, lint xanh

## Primary Proof
npm test -- roles-content-manager

## Reversibility
Revert commit.

## Provenance
Source: nghiệm thu điều phối F-1 2026-09-15 (bm-wp-117-9vy.2), evidence m10-raw.txt
Requirements: REQ-021, M-10
close_reason: manager.md Workflow reordered to 6 steps: restate + preliminary size, then delegate immediately (reuse or create the Worker before any skills check, tool search or list_agents), then failure handling, then the skills check (only after the Worker exists, rules unchanged incl. Codex via ~/.agents/skills), confirm, track. create_agent is spelled out: list_profiles once, provider bm-worker/<model of the bm-worker profile>, settings.modeId from the profile or "default" (always set), labels as before, initialPrompt contents. manager-instructions.ts regenerated. Proof: roles-content-manager (11) incl. order test (Delegate before Check skills) and create_agent parameters test; plugin-bundle-cjs byte-match green; full suite green, typecheck + lint clean. Behavioural proof (M-10) is the F-1 re-run.

title: Truyền --role khi cài lại làm tên vai trò đó về mặc định
description:
## Objective
Khi cài lại có --role cho một vai trò (đổi provider/model), tên vai trò đã đăng ký trước đó phải được giữ thay vì đặt về DEFAULT_ROLE_DISPLAY_NAMES.

## Context
Phát hiện khi sửa bm-lev 2026-09-15: nhánh flag trong configureRoles (src/roles/config.ts) vẫn dùng tên mặc định, nên cài lại với --role vừa đổi provider/model vừa ghi đè tên người dùng đã đặt. Không chặn nghiệm thu vì lượt nghiệm thu không truyền --role khi chạy lại.

## Scope
In scope:
- Nhánh --role dùng existingNames khi có
- Test: cài với tên tuỳ chọn, chạy lại với --role cho một vai trò -> tên vai trò đó giữ nguyên, chỉ provider/model đổi
Out of scope:
- Cờ đặt tên vai trò từ dòng lệnh

## Components Touched
- src/roles/config.ts, test/role-config.test.ts

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
- bm-lev (existingNames)

## Assumptions / Constraints
- Không đổi lược đồ install.json.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Cài tương tác, đặt tên Manager là Hieu.
2. Chạy lại install --apply --role manager=codex/<model>.
3. Kết quả: profile bm-manager có name Beads Manager; mong đợi Hieu.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test nêu trên xanh; role-config và install-roles vẫn xanh

## Primary Proof
npm test -- role-config

## Reversibility
Revert commit.

## Provenance
Source: báo cáo sửa bm-lev 2026-09-15
Requirements: REQ-027, M-3
close_reason: Fixed src/roles/config.ts configureRoles: the display name for each role is computed once — existingNames[role] when present and non-empty, otherwise the default — and used by both the --role (flag) branch and the reuse-record branch; --reconfigure and the no-terminal branch unchanged; install.json schema unchanged. Proof: npx vitest run test/role-config.test.ts test/install-roles.test.ts -> 71 passed incl. unit test (--role for manager keeps Hieu while switching claude/claude-opus-5, empty name falls back to default, reviewer from record, no questions; no existingNames -> default) and flow test (interactive install Hieu/Cuong/Duy, then install --apply --json --role=manager=codex/gpt-5.6-sol keeps profile name Hieu with model gpt-5.6-sol and provider extends codex, others unchanged). Agent full suite 1028 passed, typecheck + lint clean.

title: Release workflow: the verify step waits only 60 s, so a successful publish is reported as failure
description:
## Objective
The release workflow reports failure only when the publish really failed.

## Context
Release run 35047679554 (2026-09-16, first prerelease): 'Publish to npm' succeeded with provenance ('+ paseo-bm@0.1.0-alpha.0', sigstore logIndex 2854355886), and npm printed 'Your package is being processed and may take a few minutes to become available'. The next step 'Verify published version' polls npm view 6 times with 10 s sleeps, saw an empty dist-tag every time and exited 1, so the whole run is marked failure even though the release is correct. The step was added in 17f67fc together with the publish step.

## Scope
- .github/workflows/release.yml, step 'Verify published version': wait long enough for registry propagation (npm itself says minutes), for example ~20 attempts with 15 s sleeps, and print the last seen value.
- Keep the step failing when the version never appears.
- Optionally treat the first minute of empty output as expected rather than as a warning line per attempt.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Publish a new package version through the release workflow.
2. The registry needs more than 60 s to expose the dist-tag.
3. Result: the run fails although the publish succeeded.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A successful publish no longer fails the run when the registry takes a few minutes.
- A publish that truly did not land still fails the step.

## Provenance
Found by: bm-wp-118-4s4.2 first prerelease, 2026-09-16.
close_reason: Fixed in 295c3ac (contained in 6bbd938): .github/workflows/release.yml 'Verify published version' now polls 20 times with 15 s sleeps (~5 minutes) instead of 6 x 10 s, prints how long it waited on success and the last seen value on failure, and still exits 1 when the version never appears. Evidence for the original defect: release run 35047679554 published successfully ('+ paseo-bm@0.1.0-alpha.0', provenance signed, sigstore logIndex 2854355886) while npm printed 'Your package is being processed and may take a few minutes to become available'; the verify step saw an empty dist-tag on all 6 attempts and failed the run. A manual poll from a clean shell found paseo-bm@next -> 0.1.0-alpha.0 about two minutes after the publish, so the 5-minute window covers it. Proof: release.yml parses (yaml.safe_load), npm run lint exit 0, npm test 1117 passed, CI run 35048107455 success on 6bbd938 (macos/ubuntu x node 22/24). Not re-run against the real registry on purpose: dispatching release.yml on a release event would publish again.

title: Beads screen: show who works on an in-progress bead and since when
description:
## Objective
For every in-progress bead, the Beads screen shows which Worker is on it, since when, and that Worker's current state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Start = latest Worker command that set in_progress (--status in_progress, --status=in_progress, -s in_progress, --claim); last = latest Worker command or report naming the bead as a whole id.
- No start is invented; a later Worker is shown with its own activity; Reviewer and Manager turns do not count.
- List row line and detail panel with an Open the Worker button; the list still works without a trace store.
- Tests for the shell reader, the inference, the wording and the handler; typecheck, lint, tests, build pass; plugin reloads and runs.

## Provenance
Owner request in chat, 2026-09-16: "nếu có beads đang làm cần thể hiện được beads đó đang làm, làm từ bao giờ, Worker nào đang làm"
close_reason: Real daemon after reinstall install-reapply-20 (plugin running): beads.list gives cus-contact-uiux-redesign-u9zv.12 work.started = d91ccf32 at 2026-09-16T10:06:12Z (from 'br update …u9zv.12 --status=in_progress' at the end of a chained command), last 10:14:11, status idle; beads with no Worker trace return work null. Tests: plugin-shell (startsWork), plugin-bead-work (whole-id match, start vs last, reports, reviewer/manager/help ignored), plugin-beads-screen (wording, no invented start, later Worker, handler with and without trace store). typecheck/lint clean, npm test 80 files 1673 pass, build ok. README + delta owner-feedback §9.

title: Thêm ảnh chụp màn hình vào images/ cho trang listing paseo.cafe
description:
## Objective

Thư mục `images/` ở gốc repo có 2-3 ảnh chụp màn hình thật của paseo-bm trong Paseo (Metric, Beads, Setup), và README dẫn ít nhất một ảnh trong số đó.

## Context

`scripts/scan.ts` gom ảnh cho trang listing từ thư mục `images/` trước, rồi tới ảnh tham chiếu trong README. Hiện repo chỉ có `assets/paseo-bm-flow.svg` (sơ đồ, không phải ảnh chụp). Owner đã nhận việc chụp màn hình (quyết định Q4a) nên bead này **chờ file của owner**, không tự làm được: các màn hình nằm trong app Paseo, không chụp được từ agent.

## Scope

Trong: thêm file ảnh vào `images/`, và một dòng dẫn ảnh trong README nếu owner muốn. Ngoài: chụp ảnh (owner làm), chỉnh sửa giao diện, đóng ảnh vào gói npm.

## Components Touched

`images/` (mới), có thể `README.md`

## Dependencies / Prerequisites

Owner đã gửi (2026-09-23): dùng ảnh trong `/Users/Shared/work/self/paseo-plugins/paseo-bm-site/src/assets/media`. Không chặn hồ sơ registry: listing vẫn hợp lệ và vẫn có sơ đồ SVG mà README đang dẫn.

## Assumptions / Constraints

Ảnh đặt ở gốc repo (`images/`), không đặt trong `plugin/`, để không phình gói npm — `files` chỉ có `dist/` và `plugin/`. Không chụp màn hình có tên người, token hay đường dẫn riêng tư.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `images/` có ít nhất 2 ảnh chụp màn hình do owner cung cấp, định dạng png hoặc jpg.
- Ảnh không lộ credential, token, hay tên workspace riêng tư, và không mang khối Exif.
- Ảnh là ảnh sản phẩm của chính owner, không phải ảnh kho có giấy phép riêng (`CREDITS.md` của repo site ghi công Unsplash/Pexels cho M-02, M-06, M-08, M-09, M-11 — tránh đúng những tấm đó).

Phép kiểm "trang listing hiện ảnh sau lần quét kế tiếp" đã **chuyển sang §8 bước 4** của tài liệu vận hành, theo phát hiện không chặn của review b2: nó chỉ làm được sau khi PR registry được merge, tức ngoài tầm kiểm soát của bead. Phép kiểm không bị bỏ, chỉ đổi chỗ và đổi người thực hiện.

## Validation / Definition of Done

`ls images/` và mở từng ảnh xem lại một lượt trước khi push.

## Primary Proof

Danh sách file trong `images/` cùng kích thước, và một lần đọc lại từng ảnh để xác nhận không lộ thông tin riêng tư.

## Reversibility

Xoá thư mục `images/`; listing quay về chỉ dùng ảnh SVG trong README.

## Provenance

Request: req-20260923T063441Z -- "Bây giờ tôi muốn đăng ký plugin của mình lên trang này : https://paseo.cafe/submit , tôi cần làm gì và bạn có thể hỗ trợ tôi làm được những gì"

title: Khai package trong hồ sơ registry và đưa PR #215 sang xanh
description:
## Objective

PR paseo-cafe/paseo-cafe#215 khai `"package": "paseo-bm"` và job `Registry admission` chuyển sang xanh.

## Context

Lần chạy đầu đỏ ở `scripts/plugin-security/targets.ts`: hồ sơ mới bắt buộc khai `package` (run 35834044223, `TARGETS_OUTCOME: failure`). `VALIDATE_OUTCOME` đã success nên phần manifest ở gốc repo không phải sửa. Khai `package` chỉ hợp lệ sau khi 0.3.0-alpha.5 lên npm và dist-tag `latest` trỏ vào nó, vì `resolveNpmPackage` phân giải `paseo-bm@latest` bằng pacote.

## Scope

Trong: thêm một dòng `"package": "paseo-bm"` vào `registry/paseo-bm.json` trên nhánh `add-paseo-bm` của fork, cập nhật phần mô tả PR cho khớp, theo dõi CI của họ gồm bước quét an ninh. Ngoài: mọi thay đổi khác trong repo của họ, và việc merge (của maintainer).

## Components Touched

`registry/paseo-bm.json` trên `hieunt286/paseo-cafe` nhánh `add-paseo-bm`; phần mô tả PR #215

## Dependencies / Prerequisites

bm-cafe-publish-uoiq đóng xong, **và** owner đã dời dist-tag `latest` sang 0.3.0-alpha.5 (Q8a). Kiểm bằng `npm view paseo-bm dist-tags` trước khi push.

## Assumptions / Constraints

Chỉ sửa đúng một dòng trong file của chính mình; không đụng file nào khác của repo bên thứ ba. Bước `SCAN_OUTCOME` lần này mới thực sự chạy (quét an ninh gói npm) — nếu đỏ thì đọc log và báo owner, không tự ý sửa cho qua.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `registry/paseo-bm.json` trên nhánh PR có `"package": "paseo-bm"`, vẫn đúng schema `.strict()` và vẫn 6 caveat.
- `npm view paseo-bm dist-tags` cho thấy `latest` là 0.3.0-alpha.5 **trước** khi push.
- Job `Registry admission` của PR #215 kết thúc success, gồm cả bước targets và bước scan.
- Phần mô tả PR không còn câu giải thích vì sao bỏ trống ô npm, và ô thứ ba đã tick đúng sự thật.

## Validation / Definition of Done

Kết luận các check của PR đọc bằng `gh pr checks` và `gh run view --json`.

## Primary Proof

`gh pr checks 215 --repo paseo-cafe/paseo-cafe` cho thấy `Registry admission` pass, cộng log bước targets không còn ném lỗi.

## Reversibility

Bỏ dòng `package` khỏi file trên nhánh PR, hoặc đóng PR. Không đụng gì tới repo upstream cho tới khi maintainer merge.

## Provenance

title: Phát hành 0.3.0-alpha.5 lên npm kèm provenance
description:
## Objective

Bản 0.3.0-alpha.5 có trên npm, publish bằng `release.yml` kèm provenance, và tarball của nó có `paseo-plugin.json` ngay ở gốc.

## Context

Đây là điều kiện để PR paseo-cafe/paseo-cafe#215 xanh: `validate-registry.ts` tải tarball npm và đọc `paseo-plugin.json` ở gốc, `name` phải là `paseo-bm`, `version` phải khớp bản npm nó phân giải. Runbook coi việc tạo GitHub Release là **điểm phê duyệt**; owner đã duyệt ở Q7a.

## Scope

Trong: tạo tag `v0.3.0-alpha.5`, tạo GitHub Release với `--notes-file`, theo dõi `release.yml`, xác minh bản đã publish. Ngoài: dời dist-tag `latest` (owner làm, Q8a), sửa hồ sơ registry (bead khác).

## Components Touched

Git tag, GitHub Release, workflow `release.yml`, registry npm

## Dependencies / Prerequisites

bm-cafe-release-prep-pv7s đóng xong (main ở 0.3.0-alpha.5, CI xanh).

## Assumptions / Constraints

Trusted publisher đã cấu hình từ các bản trước; `release.yml` chạy theo sự kiện `release` và chỉ đặt dist-tag `next`. **Publish không đảo ngược được sau 72 giờ.** Không dùng `npm unpublish`: đường lùi của dự án là phát hành bản vá.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Tag `v0.3.0-alpha.5` có trên origin và GitHub Release tồn tại, đánh dấu prerelease.
- `release.yml` kết thúc với conclusion success, gồm bước Publish to npm và Verify published version.
- `npm view paseo-bm@next version` trả về 0.3.0-alpha.5.
- Bản trên npm có provenance (`dist.attestations`).
- Tarball đã publish chứa `paseo-plugin.json` ở gốc với `id` là `paseo-bm`.

## Validation / Definition of Done

Kết luận của workflow đọc bằng `gh run view --json`, cộng `npm view` trên bản đã publish thật.

## Primary Proof

Tải chính tarball đã publish về một thư mục `mktemp -d` rồi liệt kê gốc của nó, thay vì tin vào cấu hình lúc đóng gói.

## Reversibility

**Không đảo ngược được** sau 72 giờ: một phiên bản đã lên npm thì ở đó vĩnh viễn. Điểm không quay lại là lúc `gh release create` chạy. Đường lùi duy nhất là phát hành một bản vá cao hơn; dist-tag `latest` vẫn ở bản cũ cho tới khi owner tự dời, nên người dùng `npx paseo-bm` trần không bị ảnh hưởng trong lúc đó.

## Provenance

Workflow run 35836568020: completed -> success, đủ các bước Typecheck, Lint, Test, Build, Smoke test packed package, Assert no npm install lifecycle scripts, Publish to npm, Verify published version. Kiểm trên chính registry chứ không tin workflow: npm view cho version 0.3.0-alpha.5, dist.attestations có provenance SLSA v1, dist-tags next=0.3.0-alpha.5 còn latest vẫn 0.3.0-alpha.4 (owner tự dời, Q8a). Thư mục tạm đã xoá. Không đảo ngược được sau 72 giờ, đúng như mục Reversibility ghi.

title: Đổi tiêu đề README sang Install và Limitations and warnings
description:
## Objective

README dùng tiêu đề `## Install` và `## Limitations and warnings`, để bộ quét của paseo.cafe nhận ra mục cài đặt và mục giới hạn khi sinh trang listing.

## Context

Trang `paseo.cafe/submit` khuyến nghị README có mục tên "Install, Installation, Setup, or Getting started" và mục "Limitations, Caveats, or Known issues"; `scripts/scan.ts` trích đoạn giới hạn theo kiểu best-effort từ README. README hiện dùng `## Quick start` và `## Before you install`, không khớp danh sách nào.

## Scope

Trong: đúng hai dòng tiêu đề trong `README.md`. Ngoài: nội dung các mục (REQ-015 không đổi), `GUIDE.md`, neo `#before-you-install-read-these-warnings` của `GUIDE.md` (khác file, không ảnh hưởng).

## Components Touched

`README.md`

## Dependencies / Prerequisites

Không.

## Assumptions / Constraints

README cố ý ngắn theo REQ-015 errata (delta `prd-delta-20260918b-short-readme`): chỉ đổi tên tiêu đề, không thêm mục mới, không chuyển nội dung từ `GUIDE.md` về. Không có link nội bộ nào trỏ tới `#quick-start` hay `#before-you-install` của README (đã kiểm bằng grep toàn repo).

## Acceptance Criteria

- `README.md` có đúng một tiêu đề `## Install` và đúng một tiêu đề `## Limitations and warnings`.
- Không còn tiêu đề `## Quick start` hay `## Before you install`.
- Nội dung dưới mỗi tiêu đề không đổi một chữ nào, kiểm bằng `git diff` chỉ thấy hai dòng tiêu đề thay đổi.
- Các mục REQ-015 vẫn đủ: ảnh luồng, mô tả sơ bộ, lệnh cài một dòng, ba cảnh báo tin cậy, ghi nhận nguồn skills, link site và `GUIDE.md`.

## Validation / Definition of Done

`git diff README.md` chỉ có hai dòng đổi; đọc lại README một lượt.

## Primary Proof

`git diff --stat README.md` và `grep -n '^## ' README.md`.

## Reversibility

Đổi hai dòng tiêu đề về như cũ.

## Provenance

title: Chuẩn bị 0.3.0-alpha.5 trên main: ghi chú phát hành và bump version
description:
## Objective

`main` mang phiên bản 0.3.0-alpha.5 với ghi chú phát hành đầy đủ, `npm run verify` xanh, sẵn sàng để tạo tag.

## Context

Hồ sơ paseo.cafe chỉ hợp lệ khi entry khai `package: "paseo-bm"`, mà khai được thì tarball **đã publish** phải có `paseo-plugin.json` ở gốc. `files` đã thêm nó (commit 9d511d8) nhưng chỉ có hiệu lực từ bản publish kế tiếp. Owner duyệt phát hành ở Q7a.

## Scope

Trong: `docs/operations/paseo-bm-release-notes-0.3.0-alpha.5.md`, bump version trong `package.json`, `plugin/shared/version.ts` do build sinh lại, commit và push `main`. Ngoài: tạo tag, GitHub Release, publish (bead khác), dời dist-tag `latest` (owner làm, Q8a).

## Components Touched

`docs/operations/paseo-bm-release-notes-0.3.0-alpha.5.md` (mới), `package.json`, `plugin/shared/version.ts`

## Dependencies / Prerequisites

CI trên `main` xanh ở commit trước (run 35834527229 success).

## Assumptions / Constraints

Bump trước, build trước rồi mới verify: `scripts/generate-plugin-version.mjs` sinh `plugin/shared/version.ts` từ `package.json`, và có test ghim phiên bản payload. Ghi chú phát hành viết tiếng Việt như mọi ghi chú trong `docs/operations/`, và phải nói rõ hệ quả mới: tarball có manifest ở gốc nên `paseo plugin add npm:paseo-bm@0.3.0-alpha.5` sẽ nạp lỗi.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `package.json` và `plugin/shared/version.ts` cùng ở 0.3.0-alpha.5.
- Ghi chú phát hành tồn tại, nêu đúng những gì đổi từ 0.3.0-alpha.4 và không thổi phồng: đây là bản đóng gói, không có tính năng mới.
- Ghi chú cảnh báo rõ chuyện `paseo plugin add npm:` nạp lỗi.
- `npm run verify` exit 0 và `npm run smoke:packed` xanh.
- `main` nhận commit và CI của repo xanh trên commit đó.

## Validation / Definition of Done

`npm run verify`, `npm run smoke:packed`, và CI trên `main`.

## Primary Proof

Exit code thật của `npm run verify` đọc trực tiếp (không qua dấu ống), cộng kết luận của lần chạy CI trên `main` đọc bằng `gh run view --json`.

## Reversibility

Chưa publish gì nên lùi được hoàn toàn: revert commit bump và ghi chú, `main` về 0.3.0-alpha.4.

## Provenance

title: Thêm paseo-plugin.json ở gốc repo và test giữ hai manifest không lệch
description:
## Objective

Gốc repo có `paseo-plugin.json` giống hệt `plugin/paseo-plugin.json`, và một test giữ hai file không bao giờ lệch nhau.

## Context

CI của paseo.cafe (`scripts/validate-registry.ts`) đọc `<path>/paseo-plugin.json` trên nhánh mặc định của repo; hồ sơ `registry/paseo-bm.json` cố ý không khai `path` (quyết định owner Q1a) nên nó đọc **gốc repo**. Hiện manifest chỉ nằm trong `plugin/`, nên hồ sơ sẽ bị CI của họ từ chối với "no paseo-plugin.json found". Bối cảnh đầy đủ: `docs/operations/paseo-bm-cafe-listing-20260923.md`.

## Scope

Trong: file `paseo-plugin.json` ở gốc repo, test đồng bộ, và ba dòng trong khối "Repository layout" của `AGENTS.md` mô tả file đó. Ngoài: `files` trong `package.json` (gói npm giữ nguyên, xem §9 của tài liệu vận hành), `path`/`package` của hồ sơ registry, ảnh, README.

## Components Touched

`paseo-plugin.json` (mới), `test/plugin-structure.test.ts`, `AGENTS.md` (khối "Repository layout")

## Dependencies / Prerequisites

Không.

## Assumptions / Constraints

Không đổi `files` trong `package.json`, nên gói npm đã phát hành không đổi. Không sửa `plugin/paseo-plugin.json`. `findPayloadRoot` (`src/commands/install/manifest.ts`) tìm `<dir>/plugin/paseo-plugin.json` nên file mới ở gốc không ảnh hưởng nó.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `paseo-plugin.json` ở gốc repo parse được, `id` là `paseo-bm`, `requirements.paseo` là `>=0.8.0`.
- Nội dung parse ra bằng đúng nội dung parse ra của `plugin/paseo-plugin.json`.
- Test mới báo đỏ khi một trong hai file đổi mà file kia không đổi.
- `npm run verify` xanh.
- `git diff` không đụng `files` trong `package.json`.
- `AGENTS.md` mô tả file mới trong khối "Repository layout", và câu mô tả đó đúng ngay tại thời điểm commit — file và test đã tồn tại.

## Validation / Definition of Done

`npm run verify`.

## Primary Proof

`npx vitest run test/plugin-structure.test.ts` xanh, kèm một lần chạy đối chứng: sửa lệch file ở gốc thì test đỏ, khôi phục thì xanh lại.

## Reversibility

Xoá `paseo-plugin.json` ở gốc, test vừa thêm và ba dòng trong `AGENTS.md`; hồ sơ registry khi đó phải chuyển sang `path: "plugin"`.

## Provenance

title: Per-commit CI is one ubuntu Node 22 job and skips docs/beads-only commits
description:
## Objective
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs a single job on ubuntu-latest with Node 22 (`npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run typecheck:plugin`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`) on pushes to `main` and on pull requests, and does not run at all for a commit that only changes documentation or beads.

## Context
Owner decisions Q1a and Q2a (req-20260918T064258Z): the owner finds CI running the 2x2 matrix on every commit wasteful. Node 22 is the `engines` floor. Build, packed-package smoke, the lifecycle-script assertion, macOS and Node 24 move to `release.yml` (sibling bead `bm-ci-release-verify-hum1`). No test reads any of the ignored files (checked with grep over test/, src/ and scripts/ on 2026-09-18); `plugin/roles/*.md` is embedded into the bundle and tested, so it is NOT ignored. Design §10 errata 2026-09-18.

## Scope
In: `ci.yml` triggers (`paths-ignore` on both `push` and `pull_request`), the job (no matrix), and its steps.
Out: `release.yml`, a `workflow_dispatch` trigger for CI, caching changes, branch-protection settings on GitHub, and any new check.

## Components Touched
.github/workflows/ci.yml

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
`bm-ci-release-verify-hum1` first: the release workflow must carry the matrix, build, smoke and lifecycle checks before CI drops them.

## Assumptions / Constraints
`paths-ignore` patterns are exactly `docs/**`, `.beads/**`, `README.md`, `GUIDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `assets/**` (root-level file names match only the root files). If GitHub branch protection ever requires this check, a docs-only PR would wait for a check that never reports; the owner pushes straight to `main` today, so this is noted, not handled. Nothing may be installed (owner Q5a).

## Acceptance Criteria
- `ci.yml` parses as YAML and has exactly one job, `runs-on: ubuntu-latest`, `node-version: 22`, and no `strategy.matrix`.
- Its steps are checkout, setup-node (Node 22, npm cache), `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run typecheck:plugin`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, with no build, `smoke:packed` or lifecycle step.
- `on.push` (branches `[main]`) and `on.pull_request` both carry `paths-ignore` with exactly the seven patterns above; `plugin/roles/worker.md`, `src/index.ts` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` match none of them, and `docs/design/paseo-bm.md`, `.beads/issues.jsonl` and `README.md` match at least one.
- `permissions: contents: read` and the `concurrency` block are kept.
- The four check commands pass locally.

## Validation / Definition of Done
A structural check of the parsed YAML, including the pattern cases above (scratch script in a `mktemp -d` directory), passes, and `npm run typecheck`, `npm run typecheck:plugin`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` exit 0 locally. `npm ci` is checked structurally only and not run locally (Q5a).

## Primary Proof
The structural check output for `ci.yml`.

## Reversibility
Revert `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

## Provenance
Request: req-20260918T064258Z — "Tôi đang thấy luồng ci mỗi khi commit chạy vô duyên quá, ci cần tối giản thôi, chỉ có đối với bản release mới thật sự cầu cầu kỳ chuẩn chỉ"
Source: req-20260918T064258Z
Requirements: owner answers Q1a, Q2a, Q5a of req-20260918T064258Z (2026-09-18)
Design refs: docs/design/paseo-bm.md §10 (errata 2026-09-18) and §14 row 2026-09-18
close_reason: ci.yml: one job 'verify (ubuntu, node 22)' on ubuntu-latest, setup-node 22 with npm cache, steps npm ci, typecheck, typecheck:plugin, lint, test; no matrix, build, smoke or lifecycle step. push (main) and pull_request both carry paths-ignore docs/**, .beads/**, README.md, GUIDE.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, assets/**; permissions contents: read and concurrency kept. Proof: structural YAML check (26/26 ok, RESULT: PASS, exit 0), incl. glob cases (approximating GitHub's filter: ** crosses '/', * does not): plugin/roles/worker.md, src/index.ts, .github/workflows/ci.yml, package.json still checked; docs/design/paseo-bm.md, .beads/issues.jsonl, README.md, AGENTS.md, assets/flow.png skipped; and every command the old CI ran is in release.yml verify with the same 2x2 matrix. Negative control adding plugin/roles/** to the ignore list -> RESULT: FAIL 2. Local runs after the edit (Node 26.8.2): typecheck exit 0, typecheck:plugin exit 0, lint exit 0, npm test exit 0 (98 files / 2230 tests passed). npm ci checked structurally only, not run locally (Q5a).

title: Release workflow runs the full macOS/Linux x Node 22/24 verification before it publishes
description:
## Objective
`.github/workflows/release.yml` gains a `verify` job that runs every check on macOS + Linux x Node 22 + 24, and the existing `release` job (the one that publishes) starts only after all four combinations pass, both on a published GitHub Release and on a manual (dry-run) run.

## Context
Owner decision Q3a (req-20260918T064258Z): per-commit CI becomes minimal and only a release gets the full, careful verification. Today `release.yml` runs one ubuntu / Node 24 job while per-commit `ci.yml` runs the 2x2 matrix, so the release is checked less than an ordinary commit. Design §10 errata 2026-09-18 records the split. The sibling bead that slims `ci.yml` depends on this one, so no check is ever dropped from both workflows at once.

## Scope
In: a new `verify` job with `strategy.fail-fast: false`, matrix `os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]` x `node: [22, 24]`, steps checkout, setup-node (matrix node, npm cache), `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run typecheck:plugin`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run smoke:packed`, and the "no npm install lifecycle scripts" assertion moved from `ci.yml`; `needs: verify` on the existing `release` job.
Out: the publish steps, the `id-token: write` permission, the file name `release.yml`, the tag / dist-tag resolution, the triggers, the `release` job's own existing check steps (left as they are), and any new kind of check (coverage threshold, `npm audit signatures`).

## Components Touched
.github/workflows/release.yml

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
None.

## Assumptions / Constraints
npm trusted publishing is bound to the workflow file name `release.yml`, so the file is never renamed; `id-token: write` stays only on the `release` job and the `verify` job gets `contents: read` only. GitHub Actions cannot run from this machine and nothing may be installed (owner Q5a), so the workflow is checked structurally and its commands are run locally. Risk notes: the local runs use this machine's Node (26), not 22/24, so the matrix itself is first proven by the owner's manual Release dry-run after pushing; and because the tag check lives in the `release` job, a wrong tag now fails after the matrix instead of first (accepted: nothing publishes either way).

## Acceptance Criteria
- `release.yml` parses as YAML; `jobs.verify.strategy.matrix` is `os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]`, `node: [22, 24]`, with `fail-fast: false`.
- The `verify` job runs, in this order: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run typecheck:plugin`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run smoke:packed`, then the lifecycle-script assertion.
- The `verify` job has no `id-token: write`; `jobs.release.needs` contains `verify`; `jobs.release.permissions` is still `contents: read` + `id-token: write`.
- The triggers and every step of the `release` job are unchanged (the diff of that job is only the added `needs:`).
- Every command the `verify` job runs except `npm ci` passes locally. `npm ci` is checked structurally only (present, in order) and is NOT executed locally: it reinstalls dependencies, which Q5a rules out.

## Validation / Definition of Done
A structural check of the parsed YAML (scratch script in a `mktemp -d` directory) passes, and `npm run typecheck`, `npm run typecheck:plugin`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run smoke:packed` and the lifecycle assertion all exit 0 locally. `npm ci` is not run locally (Q5a); the owner's manual Release dry-run after pushing is where it first runs.

## Primary Proof
The structural check output for `release.yml` plus `git diff .github/workflows/release.yml` showing only the added job and `needs: verify`.

## Reversibility
Revert `.github/workflows/release.yml`; nothing else depends on the new job.

## Provenance
Request: req-20260918T064258Z — "Tôi đang thấy luồng ci mỗi khi commit chạy vô duyên quá, ci cần tối giản thôi, chỉ có đối với bản release mới thật sự cầu cầu kỳ chuẩn chỉ"
Source: req-20260918T064258Z
Requirements: owner answers Q3a, Q5a of req-20260918T064258Z (2026-09-18)
Design refs: docs/design/paseo-bm.md §10 (errata 2026-09-18) and §14 row 2026-09-18
close_reason: release.yml: new verify job (matrix os [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest] x node [22, 24], fail-fast false, permissions contents: read) runs npm ci, typecheck, typecheck:plugin, lint, test, build, smoke:packed, then the lifecycle assertion copied byte-identical from ci.yml; release job gains only 'needs: verify'. Proof: structural YAML check against HEAD's release.yml (16/16 ok: triggers, concurrency, publish job steps and id-token permission unchanged; RESULT: PASS, exit 0); negative control without needs -> 'FAIL release needs verify', exit 1; git diff --numstat 69 added / 0 removed. Local runs (Node 26.8.2, macOS, TMPDIR in a mktemp -d scratch): typecheck exit 0, typecheck:plugin exit 0, lint exit 0, npm test exit 0 (98 files / 2230 tests passed), build exit 0, smoke:packed exit 0 ('smoke (packed): all checks passed'), lifecycle assertion exit 0 ('ok: no install lifecycle scripts'); git status unchanged by build/smoke. npm ci not run locally (Q5a): checked structurally only; first real run is the owner's manual Release dry-run.

title: Setup screen in Beads Manager: role extras, skills check, br and bv
description:
## Objective
A settings icon on the Beads Manager screen opens a Setup view with: per-role additional instructions (with a full preview), the agent skills status with a Test button, and the br/bv tools status with a confirmed Install for a missing tool. The CLI warns when bv is missing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- roles.instructions returns base, extra and full; Preview renders full as Markdown.
- setup.status reports skills (ok/missing/broken per agent) and br/bv/bd (path, version); Test re-reads.
- setup.installTool runs only the documented command for a missing tool after confirmation; refuses a present tool; 300 s timeout; returns exit code and output tail.
- CLI: beads-viewer warning check and W_BEADS_VIEWER_MISSING; br install command in W_BEADS_CLI_MISSING.

title: Worker's Reviewer creation fails without a mode; profiles carry no modeId
description:
## Objective
Worker and Manager create agents with a mode that the provider accepts, on the first try.

## Context
Orchestration F-1 run 2 (2026-09-15): the Worker's first create_agent for bm-reviewer failed because it passed no settings.modeId. The retry with modeId auto worked. paseo-bm registers profiles without modeId (src/roles/register.ts), so list_profiles has none. manager.md falls back to "default", which Codex does not accept (its modes are auto, auto-review, full-access).

## Scope
plugin/roles/worker.md (Reviewer creation) and plugin/roles/manager.md (Worker creation): use the profile modeId when it has one; otherwise call inspect_provider once and use its first mode id; never pick a full-access or bypass mode. Regenerate the embedded instructions.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Install paseo-bm with roles worker=claude/claude-opus-5 and reviewer=codex/gpt-5.6-sol (profiles carry no modeId).
2. Ask Beads Manager for a Small change; the Worker creates a Reviewer with create_agent without settings.modeId.
3. Result: the first create_agent fails and no agent exists; expected: the Reviewer is created on the first attempt.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Both role files state the rule; the generated instructions match them byte for byte.
- npm run build, typecheck, lint and tests pass.
- Next orchestration run: Reviewer created on the first attempt.

## Provenance
Found by: bm-wp-117-9vy.2 orchestration acceptance, F-1 run 2.
close_reason: Fixed in 3cf656d: plugin/roles/worker.md (Reviewer creation) and manager.md (Worker creation) always set settings.modeId: the profile mode, else the first safe (else moderate) mode from one inspect_provider call, never planning/dangerous; embedded instructions regenerated by build. Proof: new assertions in test/roles-content-manager.test.ts and roles-content-worker-review.test.ts pass (71 tests across the 4 affected files), typecheck and lint exit 0; CI run 34968955646 success. Live: reinstalled r3 tarball + plugin reload (Plugin ready), doctor exit 0. Orchestration F-2 run 2: Manager c306b3ff called inspect_provider once and created Worker ded102f8 with modeId default on the first try; Worker called inspect_provider bm-reviewer once and created Reviewer 85301131 with modeId auto on the first try (no failed create_agent).

title: Cập nhật giữa hai bản prerelease (0.1.0-alpha.0 -> alpha.1) bị coi là không xếp thứ tự được nên dừng mã 5 khi không có TTY
description:
## Objective
So sánh phiên bản theo đúng quy tắc SemVer 2.0.0 cho prerelease (0.1.0-alpha.0 < 0.1.0-alpha.1 < 0.1.0), để cập nhật giữa hai bản prerelease được nhận là nâng cấp bình thường và chạy được không tương tác.

## Context
Nghiệm thu Phase 1a 2026-09-15 (evidence ~/bm-acceptance/20260915/phase1a/evidence/update.json, update.time): npx paseo-bm@0.1.0-alpha.1 install --apply --yes --skip-skills-check --json trên bản đã cài 0.1.0-alpha.0 thoát mã 5 với 'installing it needs an explicit answer on a terminal, and --yes does not give one. Nothing was written.' Planner xếp hai prerelease cùng phiên bản gốc vào 'unknown-version-order' và bắt xác nhận. Phase 1 chỉ phát hành prerelease dưới dist-tag next, nên mọi lần cập nhật không tương tác đều hỏng; M-2 không đo được.

## Scope
In scope:
- compareVersions/parseVersion (src/preflight.ts hoặc nơi planner dùng) theo SemVer §11: định danh số so theo số, chữ so theo ASCII, số < chữ, tập ngắn hơn < khi tiền tố bằng nhau, bản có prerelease < bản không có
- Planner: prerelease tăng -> upgrade không cần xác nhận; giảm -> downgrade như cũ; chỉ chuỗi thật sự không phải SemVer mới là unknown-version-order
- Test bảng theo ví dụ chuẩn SemVer §11 (1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0-alpha.1 < 1.0.0-alpha.beta < 1.0.0-beta < 1.0.0-beta.2 < 1.0.0-beta.11 < 1.0.0-rc.1 < 1.0.0) và test luồng: cập nhật 0.1.0-alpha.0 -> 0.1.0-alpha.1 không TTY với --apply --yes thoát 0
Out of scope:
- Build metadata (+...) ngoài việc bỏ qua khi so sánh

## Components Touched
- src/preflight.ts, src/commands/install/planner.ts, test/preflight.test.ts, test/install-planner.test.ts, test/install-command.test.ts

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
- Không

## Assumptions / Constraints
- Hạ cấp vẫn phải hỏi xác nhận; --yes không trả lời thay.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Cài paseo-bm 0.1.0-alpha.0 vào HOME tạm.
2. Chạy bản 0.1.0-alpha.1: install --apply --yes --skip-skills-check --json (không TTY).
3. Kết quả: exitCode 5, 'needs an explicit answer on a terminal'; mong đợi cập nhật xong, exit 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test bảng SemVer §11 và test luồng nêu trên xanh
- Test hạ cấp và unknown-version-order cho chuỗi không phải SemVer vẫn xanh
- npm test toàn bộ, typecheck, lint xanh

## Primary Proof
npm test -- install-planner

## Reversibility
Revert commit.

## Provenance
Source: nghiệm thu Phase 1a 2026-09-15 (bm-wp-120-b2e.1.2), evidence update.json, update.time
Requirements: REQ-003, REQ-010, M-2
close_reason: Fixed src/preflight.ts compareVersions to order prereleases per SemVer 2.0.0 §11 (dot-separated identifiers, numeric compared as numbers via length-then-string, numeric < alphanumeric, shorter list lower when the prefix is equal; build metadata not part of ParsedVersion); planner classifySituation unchanged apart from comments, so a higher prerelease is a plain upgrade, a lower one still a confirmed downgrade, unparseable strings still unknown-version-order. Proof: npx vitest run test/preflight.test.ts test/install-planner.test.ts test/install-command.test.ts -> green incl. the §11 chain 1.0.0-alpha < alpha.1 < alpha.beta < beta < beta.2 < beta.11 < rc.1 < 1.0.0, 0.1.0-alpha.0 < alpha.1, alpha.9 < alpha.10; planner alpha.0->alpha.1 upgrade without confirmation, alpha.1->alpha.0 downgrade with confirmation, garbage unknown; flow test: install 0.1.0-alpha.0 then 0.1.0-alpha.1 install --apply --yes --skip-skills-check --json without a TTY -> exit 0, both payload dirs, versions[] two entries with alpha.1 active. Reverting the prerelease branch to return 0 turned the 3 new tests red (flow test reproduced exit 5). Agent full suite 984 passed, typecheck + lint clean. Found in Phase 1a (update.json exitCode 5).

title: Plugin không nạp được trên Paseo 0.8: Invalid URL do import.meta.url trong bundle CJS
description:
## Objective
Plugin paseo-bm nạp được và đạt status running trên Paseo 0.8: bỏ mọi phụ thuộc vào vị trí file lúc chạy trong code server; nhúng nội dung roles/manager.md vào bundle lúc build; roles.describe đọc cấu hình vai trò đang có hiệu lực từ Paseo thay vì install.json.

## Context
Nghiệm thu Phase 1a 2026-09-15: paseo plugin logs paseo-bm báo 'Plugin failed to load: Invalid URL'; plugin status failed; install thoát mã 7. Đã kiểm mã Paseo 0.8 (app.asar): compileTarget dùng esbuild bundle format cjs, platform node, target node20; tiến trình con được fork không đặt cwd; PluginServerContext không có thư mục plugin. Trong bundle CJS, import.meta rỗng nên new URL('./roles/manager.md', import.meta.url) và new URL('../../install.json', import.meta.url) ở đầu plugin/index.server.ts ném Invalid URL. Code server không có cách nào biết thư mục của chính nó (import.meta.url, __dirname, process.cwd() đều không dùng được).

Quyết định owner 2026-09-15: roles.describe đọc bm-* providers và profiles đang có hiệu lực qua API cấu hình của Paseo SDK (đúng thứ Paseo thật sự dùng, chạy được với mọi install home); instructionsPath trỏ tới tên chỉ dẫn nhúng trong bundle (ví dụ roles/manager.md). Ghi errata Design §5.

## Scope
In scope:
- Bỏ import.meta.url, __dirname, process.cwd() khỏi plugin/index.server.ts và plugin/server/*
- Sinh lúc build một module TS chứa nội dung roles/manager.md (theo mẫu scripts/generate-plugin-version.mjs), giữ roles/*.md trong payload; test khẳng định module sinh ra khớp từng byte với roles/manager.md
- roles.describe đọc agents.providers.bm-* và daemon.agentProfiles[bm-*] qua Paseo SDK (tra typings thật, không đoán API); provider = extends, model từ profile, paseoTools = providers.<id>.paseoTools.enabled; instructionsPath là tên chỉ dẫn nhúng
- Test hồi quy mô phỏng đúng cách Paseo 0.8 nạp: bundle plugin/index.server.ts bằng esbuild format cjs platform node (external @getpaseo/* và zod), require bundle, gọi contribute với server giả — không được ném lỗi và manager.ensure dùng đúng nội dung chỉ dẫn
- Errata Design §5 cho nguồn dữ liệu của roles.describe
Out of scope:
- Giao diện client (không đổi hợp đồng ngoài instructionsPath)

## Components Touched
- plugin/index.server.ts, plugin/server/roles.ts, plugin/server/manager.ts, plugin/shared/contracts.ts (nếu cần), scripts/ (sinh module chỉ dẫn), package.json script build, test/, docs/design/paseo-bm.md §5

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
- Không

## Assumptions / Constraints
- Không thêm dependency runtime; esbuild đã có qua tsup cho test.
- Chỉ dẫn vai trò vẫn là tiếng Anh và vẫn nằm trong payload để có hash.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Cài paseo-bm 0.1.0-alpha.0 từ tarball, đồng ý bật plugin.
2. paseo plugin ls --json -> paseo-bm status failed; paseo plugin logs paseo-bm -> 'Plugin failed to load: Invalid URL'.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test hồi quy bundle CJS xanh (và đỏ trên mã cũ — ghi lại bằng chứng đã chạy trên mã cũ)
- Không còn import.meta, __dirname, process.cwd() trong plugin/ (test quét mã nguồn)
- roles.describe test đọc từ cấu hình Paseo giả: đủ ba vai trò, paseoTools đúng theo dạng {enabled}
- npm test toàn bộ, typecheck, typecheck:plugin, lint xanh
- Kiểm tay ghi vào close reason: paseo plugin install thư mục payload tạm (không phải cài của người dùng) đạt status running rồi paseo plugin remove — chỉ làm khi owner cho phép; nếu không, nêu rõ là chưa kiểm trên daemon thật

## Primary Proof
npm test -- plugin-bundle-cjs

## Reversibility
Revert commit.

## Provenance
Source: nghiệm thu Phase 1a 2026-09-15 (bm-wp-120-b2e.1.2), evidence plugins.after-install.json, paseo plugin logs
Requirements: REQ-005(b), REQ-020, M-7
Design refs: docs/design/paseo-bm.md §2.3, §5
close_reason: Fixed two load-time defects of the plugin on Paseo 0.8. (1) Invalid URL: removed import.meta.url/install.json reads from plugin/index.server.ts; Manager instructions embedded at build time (scripts/generate-role-instructions.mjs -> plugin/server/manager-instructions.ts, byte-for-byte test); roles.describe reads effective bm-* providers/profiles via paseo.config.get (owner decision, Design §5 errata). (2) Found by the real-daemon check after fix 1: 'Plugin server bundle must default export a function' — Paseo's compiler applies makeHermesInteropEager (getters -> eager copies) and wrapCommonJsBundle, so a late-bound  is copied while undefined; both plugin/index.server.ts and plugin/index.client.tsx now use a hoisted . title: Diagnose the Paseo desktop freeze when the Changes sidebar opens
description:
## Objective
Name, with measured evidence, what makes the Paseo desktop app (macOS, 0.8.0) stop responding when the Changes sidebar/tab is opened on a workspace.

## Context
Reported by the user on 2026-09-23: opening the Changes file sidebar freezes the whole app. Paseo is a third-party app here; only the installed bundle (/Applications/Paseo.app) is available, so the diagnosis reads the shipped daemon code (app.asar, unminified) and the renderer bundle, and measures the real pipeline offline against the user's own workspaces.

## Scope
In: root-cause analysis with numbers, plus the workaround the user can apply today. Out: any code change (the defect is in Paseo itself, not in paseo-bm), any change to the user's Paseo config, and any live checkout-diff subscription against the running daemon.

## Components Touched
None in this repository. Read-only: /Applications/Paseo.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar, the renderer bundle, ~/.paseo logs, git state of the registered workspaces.

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
None.

## Assumptions / Constraints
Read-only investigation. No network, no install, no change to the user's daemon or config. Probe code lives in a throwaway mktemp directory.

## Acceptance Criteria
The cause is stated as a chain from "open Changes" to "app unresponsive", each link backed either by the shipped source or by a measurement.
The magnitude is quantified for at least one real workspace of the user: payload size, token count, highlight time per refresh.
The reason the WHOLE app freezes, not just the panel, is explained.
A workaround the user can apply without an app change is given.

## Validation / Definition of Done
Numbers reproduced by running the app's own diff + highlight pipeline (extracted from app.asar) over the user's workspaces.

## Primary Proof
Offline run of the daemon's own parseAndHighlightDiff over the registered workspaces, reporting files, diff lines, tokens, payload MB and highlight ms per refresh.

## Reversibility
Nothing is changed; the scratch directory is deleted.

## Provenance
Request: req-20260923T045814Z - "ung dung paseo tren desktop MacOS cu mo side bar Changes file la no do luon, van de do gi vay"
Ad-hoc user request; not a work package of docs/plans/paseo-bm-implementation-plan-v2.md.
close_reason:
Root cause found and measured. Corrected after review b1, which found three blocking errors in the first close reason: the figures were taken WITHOUT the daemon's 2MB patch budget, chain link 4 named the wrong cap as operative, and a live renderer CPU observation was placed as corroboration when it is not. All three are fixed below and the wrong figures are gone.

Chain, each link from the shipped code (paths inside /Applications/Paseo.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar) or from a measurement:

1) Opening Changes calls subscribe_checkout_diff with includeStructured:true (checkout-diff-manager.js: computeCheckoutDiffSnapshot -> workspaceGit.getCheckoutDiff).
2) getCheckoutDiff walks the changed and untracked files that fit a budget (see link 4). For each file it KEEPS, buildHighlightedTrackedDiffFile spawns git show for the old blob, then highlightDiffWithFileContent calls highlightCode up to 4x over FULL file contents: reconstructed old, reconstructed new, the full old blob, and the file re-read from disk. A 3-line edit in a 2,000-line file tokenizes the whole file, twice over. Per-file git spawns are batched 8 at a time for tracked diffs and run one file at a time for untracked.
3) @getpaseo/highlight highlightCode is per-character: `Array.from({length: code.length}, () => null)` (one array slot per character), then a per-character loop with a string compare (`charStyle === currentToken.style`) and a per-character string append (`currentToken.text += line[i]`). Measured throughput on the user's own files: 1,477 chars/ms (XDataTable.tsx, 41KB), 1,408 chars/ms (SubscriberService.ts, 66KB) ~= 1.4 MB/s, synchronous on the daemon's single Node thread.
4) CORRECTED. TOTAL_DIFF_MAX_BYTES = 2MB is the BINDING cap and it bounds WHICH files are tokenized, not how big the result is: in processTrackedChanges a tracked file whose patch would cross the 2MB running total becomes a `too_large` placeholder and never reaches buildHighlightedTrackedDiffFile, and the untracked loop `break`s once the cumulative budget is reached, so those files are never read at all. The cost per KEPT file is set by full file contents, not by patch size, so a 2MB patch budget still yields an ~8-11MB token frame and ~1s of synchronous highlighting. CHECKOUT_DIFF_MAX_STRUCTURED_BYTES (~23MB: base64/encrypt-inverse of the 32MiB relay frame, minus 1MiB headroom) is only a fail-safe: crossing it makes appendStructuredFile return false and the panel gets `diffTooLarge: true` with an empty file list - a useless panel, not a freeze. The earlier claim that the ~23MB cap is what lets the payload grow was wrong.
5) Every refresh also JSON.stringify()s the payload twice on the daemon: once per file in appendStructuredFile to measure bytes, once in refreshTarget for the fingerprint.
6) CHECKOUT_DIFF_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 150: any working-tree change re-runs steps 2-5 in full with force:true, so the 64-entry WORKSPACE_GIT_CHECKOUT_DIFF_CACHE is bypassed, and refreshTarget re-queues (refreshQueued) if another change lands while one refresh is running.

MEASURED, with the daemon's budget applied exactly as checkout-git.js applies it (per-file 1MB cap, 2MB running total for tracked, break for untracked), running the app's own parseDiff + highlightDiffWithFileContent including the per-file `git show` that the first probe omitted. Uncommitted mode:
  /Users/Shared/work/dx/backends/report   99 files sent (8 tracked + 91 untracked), 365 untracked files never read, 20,746 diff lines, 172,915 tokens, 8.57 MB frame, highlight 812-878 ms, whole refresh step 6.0-8.1 s wall
  /Users/Shared/work/dx/frontend/xspace/xspace-report   240 files sent, 35 untracked never read, 27,590 diff lines, 237,603 tokens, 10.81 MB frame, highlight 1,152 ms, whole refresh step 15.0 s wall
  /Users/Shared/work/self/paseo-plugins/paseo-bm   1 file, 25 lines, 0 tokens, 0.11 MB, highlight 1 ms  (control: no freeze)
Reviewer b1 independently reproduced the same gate and got 8.57 MB / 172,915 tokens / 734 ms for backends/report and 8.36 MB / 162,184 tokens / 1,123 ms for xspace-report in base mode. The wall-clock figure is an upper bound on the daemon's: my probe spawns git serially where the daemon batches tracked diffs 8 at a time. Only the highlight slice blocks the event loop; the git spawns are awaited.

Renderer side, measured on the GATED 8.57 MB frame (the earlier figures came from the ungated 14.68 MB one and are withdrawn): JSON.parse 42 ms, walk of the generated schema validator over all 172,915 tokens 6 ms, row+token model build 13 ms, 41 MB heap. So the renderer's per-frame cost is ~60 ms - modest, and NOT the bottleneck.

Why the app stops responding: the expensive part is the daemon, not the renderer. Per refresh it burns 0.8-1.2 s of SYNCHRONOUS highlight CPU on its single Node thread - while that runs the daemon answers nothing, so every surface that depends on it (timeline, agent traffic, composer) stalls - and the whole refresh takes seconds of wall time. With a 150 ms debounce, force:true and refreshQueued, a workspace whose files keep changing (a dev server, or an agent editing) never lets the refresh catch up: it re-runs back to back for as long as the Changes panel stays subscribed. The diff body itself is canvas-painted (getContext("2d"), 16 sites) and windowed (resolveVisibleFileSections) in the renderer bundle, with tokenizeToLines refusing anything over MAX_HIGHLIGHT_CHARS = 1e5, so the freeze is the daemon pipeline, not DOM count.

NOT evidence for this pipeline, recorded to prevent the mistake being repeated: renderer helper pid 95767 was seen at 160-318% CPU and ~1.0 GB RSS during this work, but ~/.paseo/daemon.log reports checkoutDiffSubscriptionCount:0 throughout (1,174 metric records, last five all 0, freshest 12:19:52), so NO Changes subscription was open and that CPU belongs to something else - an embedded browser tab on localhost:4201 forwarding 20-57 console lines per second from a looping webpack HMR. It is a separate problem and must not be cited as proof of the Changes freeze.

Workaround without an app change: keep the number of changed + untracked files small before opening Changes (commit, stash, or gitignore generated output - 456 of the files in backends/report are untracked, and 365 of them are past the budget, so they cost git reads on every refresh while never being shown), and keep the Changes tab closed in a workspace where a dev server or an agent writes files continuously, since each write re-runs the whole pipeline 150 ms later. Real fix is upstream in Paseo: lazy per-file diffs (its own comment says "Temporary until diffs load lazily per file"), highlight only the hunk lines instead of whole files, and move highlightCode off the event loop.

Checks re-run at close: `br lint -s all` -> bm-dop3 clean (2 pre-existing warnings on bm-wp-242-manager-dywt / bm-wp-242-flag-bh04, untouched); `br dep cycles` -> no cycles. No file in this repository was changed except .beads/issues.jsonl. Scratch directory deleted.

Review b1 non-blocking findings, NOT actioned (left for the user): labels are feature:changes-sidebar-freeze + area:paseo-app rather than the repo's feature:paseo-bm + phase:* + wp:* convention, which Provenance justifies as an ad-hoc request outside the plan; and the first create+close of this bead was swept into release commit 7d62a16 by concurrent work, so it does not sit under a commit of its own.

title: Live test: a failing Claude Code Worker is replaced by an OpenCode Worker (big-pickle)
description:
## Objective
On the real Paseo daemon, a Worker agent on `bm-worker-fallback-1/claude-haiku-4-5` whose Claude Code turn is refused by Anthropic (a made-up API key on that alias) records one fallback incident, and `fallback.act` `switch` replaces it with a Worker on `bm-worker-fallback-2` running `opencode/big-pickle` that sends a `received` BM-REPORT.

## Context
The fallback path (phases 2a-16..2a-18) is proven only by automated tests; the owner wants to see Claude Code -> OpenCode work end to end. Claude Code works on this machine, so the failure is induced. Owner answers (req-20260922T065007Z): Q1 a — temporary two-entry Worker chain, fake key on fallback-1 only, the primary `bm-worker`, the Manager and this Worker untouched; Q2 b — `opencode/big-pickle` (free; OpenCode Zen free models may use the data); Q3 a — switch through the plugin RPC `fallback.act` from a scratch script, the same handler the card button calls; Q4 a — cleanup below; Q5 a — results in chat and reports only, no document change.

## Scope
In: a key-only snapshot of Paseo's config; `roles.save-fallback` for role `worker`, policy `ask`, entries [claude · claude-haiku-4-5, opencode · opencode/big-pickle]; `env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` = a made-up value on `bm-worker-fallback-1` through the daemon config patch; one test Worker (child of this Worker, its own request id); `fallback.incidents` and `fallback.act` `switch`; observing the replacement up to its `received`; the cleanup.
Out: the L1 "Wait" path (needs a real usage-limit reset time), Reviewer and Manager fallback, the Auto policy, any plugin or repository change, checklist updates (Q5 a), archiving or deleting agents.

## Components Touched
`~/.paseo/config.json` through the daemon config API only (`agents.providers.bm-worker-fallback-1`, `bm-worker-fallback-2`); `~/.paseo-bm/role-fallback.json` (created by the save, deleted at cleanup); `~/.paseo-bm/role-fallback-state.json` (written by the plugin, kept); two new agents. No repository file.

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
none — the running plugin payload already carries the fallback code (`diff -rq plugin ~/.paseo-bm/plugin/0.2.0-alpha.1` is empty), OpenCode and Claude are `available`, no chain is configured.

## Assumptions / Constraints
- Never change `bm-worker`, `bm-manager`, `bm-reviewer`, any non-`bm-*` provider or any profile; never restart the daemon or reload the plugin.
- Never read or copy secrets: the snapshot holds only `agents.providers`, `daemon.agentProfiles` and a sha256 of the rest of the file, never a full copy. The fake key is a made-up string, not a real credential.
- The test Worker is created with Paseo `create_agent`: provider `bm-worker-fallback-1/claude-haiku-4-5`, title `Fallback test Worker (Claude, fake key)`, labels `bm.role` = `worker`, `bm.requestId` = the test request id, `bm.version` = `0.2.0-alpha.1`, and an EXPLICIT `settings.modeId` = `bypassPermissions` (the Worker posture on Claude, owner decision on sub-agent modes). Paseo resolves the mode before the plugin hook runs and refuses a child that has to inherit one (AGENTS.md, `cannot inherit mode`), so the mode is never left out. Before creating, `list_providers` must list `bypassPermissions` among the modes of `bm-worker-fallback-1`; if it does not, or the creation is refused, stop and ask.
- The test Worker uses a fresh `req-<UTC now>` id, not req-20260922T065007Z, so the sole-Worker rule of this request is not broken.
- Scratch scripts live in one `mktemp -d` directory, deleted before the next report.
- If the fake key does not make Claude Code fail, or the failure classifies as L3/L6, stop and ask; do not try another way of breaking Claude without asking.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. After the save, `agents.providers` has `bm-worker-fallback-1` (extends `claude`) and `bm-worker-fallback-2` (extends `opencode`), `role-fallback.json` has `roles.worker` with the two entries in that order, and no other provider or profile differs from the snapshot (checklist 16.1).
2. The test Worker's first turn ends on a Claude Code auth error; `role-fallback-state.json` then has one incident with `role: worker`, `agentId` = the test Worker, a fallback class (expected L4), `status: pending`, and candidate `bm-worker-fallback-2` · `opencode` · `opencode/big-pickle`; a `BM-FALLBACK` with `status: pending` reaches this Worker's chat (16.2).
3. `fallback.act {incidentId, action: "switch"}` returns the incident `switched` with a `replacementId`; within 60 s that agent exists, titled "Beads Worker (fallback)", on `bm-worker-fallback-2` with `opencode/big-pickle`, labelled `bm.replaces` = the test Worker; the test Worker carries `bm.replacedBy` = the replacement (16.4).
4. The replacement's first message starts with `BM-HANDOVER` (`role: worker`, the test request id) and it sends a `received` BM-REPORT to this Worker.
5. Cleanup: `roles.save-fallback` for `worker` with no entries removes both aliases; `role-fallback.json` is deleted; `agents.providers` and `daemon.agentProfiles` equal the snapshot; `role-fallback-state.json` and both agents are kept.

## Validation / Definition of Done
Each criterion read back from its own source: the RPC outputs, `jq` over config keys, `get_agent_status` of both agents, this Worker's timeline for `BM-FALLBACK` and `BM-REPORT`, and the snapshot comparison after cleanup.

## Primary Proof
The `fallback.act` output with `status: switched`, plus `get_agent_status` of the replacement showing provider `bm-worker-fallback-2`, model `opencode/big-pickle` and label `bm.replaces`, plus its `received` BM-REPORT.

## Reversibility
`roles.save-fallback` for `worker` with no entries removes both aliases (and the fake key with them); delete `role-fallback.json`, which did not exist before; nothing in the repository changes. If a save fails midway, remove the two aliases through the config patch and compare with the snapshot. The two agents stay for the owner to archive.

## Risks / Gotchas
- The replacement Worker runs the full Worker role and may go past its `received` (size the request, create a bead or a Reviewer). The test request forbids that; if it starts anyway, send it a stop and record it as a finding, not a failure of the switch.
- Paseo may apply the alias `env` only to new agents, and Claude Code may prefer a stored login over `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`: if the test Worker's turn succeeds, that is the stop-and-ask case of the constraints.
- The test Worker's initial prompt (verbatim, so the handover's "Original request" is known): `Fallback smoke test <test request id>. Manager agent id: <this Worker's id>. Change no file, create no bead and no agent. Send a received BM-REPORT to the Manager agent id, then a finished one, and stop.`

## Provenance
Request: req-20260922T065007Z — "Thử test fallback từ Claude Code sang OpenCode chọn bừa 1 model rẻ tiền xem có hoạt động hay không"
Source: req-20260922T065007Z owner answers Q1 a, Q2 b, Q3 a, Q4 a, Q5 a
Requirements: REQ-065 (checklist 16.1, 16.2, 16.4)
Design refs: docs/design/paseo-bm-delta-20260921-worker-fallback-and-role-settings.md §4.4.1–§4.4.8
close_reason: Live test passed on the real daemon (2026-09-22 07:03-07:08Z). AC1: roles.save-fallback worker [claude·claude-haiku-4-5, opencode·opencode/big-pickle] wrote bm-worker-fallback-1 (extends claude) + -2 (extends opencode) and role-fallback.json (0600); diff of other providers/profiles vs snapshot empty, rest-of-file sha 0c30415b9ad26cde unchanged. Fake ANTHROPIC_API_KEY patched on fallback-1 only. AC2: test Worker fa13898e (bm-worker-fallback-1/claude-haiku-4-5, bypassPermissions, req-20260922T070400Z) ended 'Failed to authenticate. API Error: 401 API key is invalid.' (0 output tokens); incident fb-d3c9430912b2 role worker class L4 signal completed status pending candidate bm-worker-fallback-2·opencode·opencode/big-pickle; BM-FALLBACK status pending reached this Worker's chat. AC3: fallback.act switch at 07:06:23Z returned switched, replacementId 1b4fbac9 created 07:06:30Z (~7 s), title 'Beads Worker (fallback)', runtimeInfo provider bm-worker-fallback-2 model opencode/big-pickle mode bytes auto_accept true, label bm.replaces=fa13898e; fa13898e got bm.replacedBy=1b4fbac9; BM-FALLBACK status switched followed. AC4: replacement's first message BM-HANDOVER role worker requestId req-20260922T070400Z with the verbatim request; it ran git status/diff and sent received then finished BM-REPORTs to this Worker, no file/bead/agent. AC5: roles.save-fallback worker [] removed both aliases, revision back to 315723b3 (original), role-fallback.json deleted, providers+profiles diff vs snapshot empty, rest sha unchanged; role-fallback-state.json and both agents kept.

title: Worker bỏ qua hợp đồng vai trò khi skill feature-workflow dẫn hướng khác: review không qua Reviewer, tạo tài liệu ở mức Small, thiếu nhãn feature, báo cáo sai công cụ
description:
## Objective
Chỉ dẫn Worker (plugin/roles/worker.md) phải thắng mọi hướng dẫn của skill bên thứ ba: review luôn bằng một Reviewer agent (profile bm-reviewer); mức Small không tạo bất kỳ file tài liệu mới nào; mọi bead tạo ra có nhãn feature:<slug> theo hợp đồng nhãn; báo cáo gửi Manager bằng công cụ send_agent_prompt của Paseo.

## Context
Nghiệm thu điều phối F-1 (2026-09-15, evidence ~/bm-acceptance/20260915/evidence/F-1, timeline-worker-8d5d3514.txt): Worker phân loại Small đúng, sửa đúng và test xanh, nhưng (1) review bằng skill code-review trong chính phiên của nó, không tạo Reviewer — vi phạm §2.6 C, REQ-024, M-14; (2) viết docs/plans/invoice-date-format-quick.md theo biến thể lightweight của feature-workflow — vi phạm quy tắc Small không tạo tài liệu mới, M-18; (3) bead chỉ có nhãn req-… và size:small, không có feature:<slug> — vi phạm hợp đồng nhãn §2.6 A, REQ-033, M-11; (4) gọi SendMessage (lỗi agent not found) rồi mới dùng send_agent_prompt.

## Scope
In scope:
- Thêm vào worker.md một mục ưu tiên: khi skill (feature-workflow, implementing-beads, code-review…) gợi ý khác, chỉ dẫn vai trò này thắng; nêu rõ ba điểm trên
- Review: chỉ tính là review khi đã tạo Reviewer agent profile bm-reviewer qua công cụ create_agent của Paseo; cấm dùng skill review hay tự review thay thế
- Small: không tạo file tài liệu mới (kể cả quick brief/plan của feature-workflow); ghi phân loại và kế hoạch ngắn vào mô tả bead
- Nhãn: mọi bead do Worker tạo phải có feature:<slug> (và area/component khi xác định được) trước khi đóng; kiểm lại nhãn trước khi báo beads-done
- Báo cáo: dùng send_agent_prompt với agent id của Manager; không dùng SendMessage
- Test nội dung cho từng quy tắc (roles-content-worker-*), sinh lại payload, plugin-structure xanh
Out of scope:
- Sửa skill bên thứ ba

## Components Touched
- plugin/roles/worker.md, test/roles-content-worker-*.test.ts

## Dependencies / Prerequisites
- Không

## Assumptions / Constraints
- Chỉ dẫn viết tiếng Anh.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Nghiệm thu F-1: gửi yêu cầu sửa định dạng ngày cho Beads Manager.
2. Worker hoàn tất: không có Reviewer agent nào trong workspace, có file docs/plans/*-quick.md mới, bead thiếu nhãn feature:*.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test nội dung khẳng định từng quy tắc và mục ưu tiên so với skill
- npm test toàn bộ, typecheck, lint xanh
- Lượt nghiệm thu lại F-1 cho: có Reviewer agent bm-reviewer, 0 file tài liệu mới, bead có feature:* (ghi ở bm-wp-117-9vy.2)

## Primary Proof
npm test -- roles-content-worker

## Reversibility
Revert commit.

## Provenance
Source: nghiệm thu điều phối F-1 2026-09-15 (bm-wp-117-9vy.2)
Requirements: REQ-024, REQ-033, REQ-034, REQ-036, M-11, M-14, M-18
close_reason: worker.md now opens with 'These role instructions override any skill' (inside ## Role) listing four binding rules, each repeated where the Worker acts: review counts only via a Reviewer agent created with Paseo create_agent using profile bm-reviewer (review skills such as code-review or self-review never substitute); Small creates no new document file, not even feature-workflow's quick brief/plan (classification and short plan go in the bead description); every created or updated bead carries feature:<slug>, re-checked before beads-done; reports go to Manager with send_agent_prompt, never SendMessage. Proof: roles-content-worker-review (19) and roles-content-worker-triage (13) gained tests for each rule and the override section; full suite green, typecheck + typecheck:plugin + lint clean. Behavioural proof is the F-1 re-run recorded on bm-wp-117-9vy.2.

title: Dashboard: step and skill chips, top 5 heaviest Workers
description:
## Objective
Show feature-workflow steps and loaded skills as coloured chips, and add a "top 5 heaviest Workers" chart the owner can open agents from.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Each step is a chip: green done (reported), blue done (inferred), grey not needed, amber unknown; a legend is shown.
- Skills are chips on the request node (union) and on each agent node.
- TraceSummary carries per-Worker usage and title; the chart ranks Workers by tokens across requests, top 5, with cost and the request, and opens the agent on press.
- Tests cover chips, the legend and the ranking.

## Provenance
Owner, 2026-09-16: chips for workflow steps and skills; "hiển thị top 5 Worker làm việc nặng".
